components: For a connected triangle-free simple graph every nonbacktracking two-step route has exactly one alternative with the same endpoints. A genuine odd return plus minimal degree or size yields a 16-state five-direction carrier via volume bounds for its bipartite double cover.
candidates.declared_status: A minimal finite relational candidate, not a model of spacetime or matter. Graphs with higher degree and odd returns are retained.
missing_bridges: Explain why these local relations and minimality hold for physical processes. Repeated local signals do not certify the same vertex.
